comparison.objective: Free an entangled tote strap and lower the tote safely; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires deformable-entanglement handling, hazard recognition, tote support, and careful lowering. Candidate requires precision tool access, screw/collar manipulation, and iterative rigid-body impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the tote released on the table, rake retained, and contents preserved. Candidate requires two safe, repeatable axial stops within numeric energy, force, travel, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: The deformable hazard-removal task has no meaningful overlap with damper adjustment or dynamic validation.
